title: 7 Ryecourt Woods, Cloughduv, Co. Cork, P14W500
seoTitle: 7 Ryecourt Woods, Cloughduv, Co. Cork, P14W500
description:
This superb five-bedroom detached family home measuring 227m2  is presented in true turnkey condition and offers spacious, well-designed accommodation finished to an exceptional standard throughout. Designed with modern family living in mind, the property features bright, generously proportioned living spaces, including a spacious living room, an open-plan kitchen/dining area, utility room, guest WC, five well-appointed bedrooms, including a principal bedroom with en-suite, walk-in-wardrobe and a contemporary family bathroom.
Situated in the highly regarded Ryecourt Woods development in Cloughduv, the property enjoys a peaceful village setting while remaining within easy reach of Ballincollig, Macroom and Cork City via the nearby N22. Cloughduv offers a welcoming community atmosphere with local amenities including a primary school, shop, sports facilities and beautiful surrounding countryside, making it an excellent location for family living.
Boasting an A-rated BER, the property offers excellent energy efficiency, lower running costs and comfortable year-round living.

Entrance  Hallway - 3.96m x 5.06m
A bright and welcoming entrance hall sets the tone for the home, featuring attractive wood-effect tiled flooring, a feature pendant light and a spacious layout. The hall benefits from a practical under-stairs storage area and a separate cloakroom, while the staircase, illuminated by a large window, leads to the first floor. Access is provided to all principal ground floor accommodation.

Family Room – 4.23m x 4.51m
This bright and spacious family room offers an ideal space to relax and unwind. Large, glazed patio doors flood the room with natural light while providing seamless access to the rear garden, creating an excellent indoor-outdoor flow. Finished in a contemporary style, this versatile reception room is perfectly suited to modern family living or entertaining.

Home Office – 2.41m x 2.79m
A bright and versatile home office overlooking the front of the property, offering an ideal space for remote working, studying or use as a playroom, with excellent natural light and a practical layout. 

Guest WC – 1.52m x 1.48m
A contemporary, fully tiled guest WC featuring modern sanitary ware, a vanity unit with storage, and a stylish illuminated LED mirror, providing both practicality and a high-quality finish.

Kitchen/Dining – K 4.99m x 4.10m/ D 5.25m x 4.30m
This beautifully appointed kitchen is finished to an exceptional standard and features bespoke shaker-style cabinetry, elegant quartz worktops and matching splashbacks. A central island with integrated power provides additional preparation space and informal seating, while the gas hob, quality integrated appliances, recessed spot lighting and feature pendant lighting create a stylish and practical workspace. A door to the rear garden offers convenient outdoor access, making this an ideal space for both everyday family living and entertaining. 

Utility Room – 2.28m x 1.83m
The utility room is fitted with tiled flooring, ample built-in storage and a practical worktop with plumbing for a washing machine. A rear-facing window provides natural light.

Stairs & Landing
The carpeted stairs lead to a bright and spacious first-floor landing, providing access to all first-floor accommodation. A Stira folding attic staircase gives access to a large, fully floored and wired attic, offering excellent additional storage space. 

Bedroom 1 – (Primary Suite) – Entrance 1.68m x 2.64m Room – 4.23m x 3.49m
A spacious and beautifully presented principal bedroom overlooking the front of the property, featuring a large picture window that fills the room with natural light. Finished with plush carpeting, the room offers generous space for bedroom furniture and benefits from a walk-in wardrobe/dressing area with additional storage, together with a stylish en-suite, creating a comfortable and private retreat.

Ensuite – 1.77m x 2.35m.  Walk In Closet – 2.36m x 2.34m
A beautifully appointed, fully tiled en-suite featuring a spacious curved shower enclosure with a rainfall shower, contemporary vanity unit with integrated storage, illuminated LED mirror, WC and a chrome heated towel rail.

Bedroom 2  - 3.36m x 3.94m
A bright and spacious double bedroom overlooking the rear of the property, finished with wood-effect flooring and benefiting from a large fitted sliding wardrobe, providing excellent storage. This well-proportioned room offers ample space for additional bedroom furniture, making it ideal for family living or guests.

Ensuite – 1.68m x 2.09m
A stylish, fully tiled en-suite featuring a corner shower with a contemporary glass enclosure, vanity unit with integrated storage, WC and modern sanitary ware. Finished to a high standard with quality fittings, this bright and practical space complements the second bedroom perfectly.

Bedroom 3 – 4.23m x 3.58m
A generous double bedroom featuring plush carpeting and a large window that fills the room with natural light. This spacious bedroom offers ample room for additional furniture, making it ideal as a guest room, children's bedroom or a comfortable space for growing families.

Bedroom 4 – 4.41m x 3.19m 
A spacious double bedroom overlooking the front of the property, finished with wood-effect flooring and enjoying excellent natural light from the large window.

Bedroom 5 – 3.68m x 3.20m
A spacious and versatile room, finished with wood-effect flooring and filled with natural light. Currently utilised as a home gym and office, this adaptable space would also make an ideal fifth bedroom, games room, playroom or home office, catering to a variety of modern family needs.

Family Bathroom – 2.13m x 2.79m
A beautifully finished, fully tiled family bathroom featuring a bath, separate walk-in shower with rainfall showerhead, vanity unit with integrated storage, WC and a frosted window providing natural light and ventilation.
